development.question: A dashboard gives a Coptic civil date. What can this tell me about my day through an Egyptian lens?

evidence.text: The Coptic calendar is an implemented civil calendar. It is historically related to Egyptian calendrical traditions, but its civil date alone is not a reconstruction of an ancient Egyptian natal or auspicious-day system. No such personal forecast is supplied.
evidence.sourceLocator: Egyptian history and the calculated Coptic date

facts.description: Do not infer an ancient personal forecast

scenarioCriteria: Offer a source-study or ordinary planning use without inventing a favorable/adverse verdict.

development.question: Under the supplied GMT correlation, how should I interpret 13.0.0.0.0 on 21 December 2012?

evidence.text: For this fixture the GMT correlation constant is 584283 and the stated Gregorian correspondence is 2012-12-21 = Long Count 13.0.0.0.0. This marks a calendar cycle completion; it does not establish a predicted physical end of the world.

development.question: Does Dee’s Monas Hieroglyphica give this app a numerical personal day-prediction algorithm?

evidence.text: John Dee’s Monas Hieroglyphica was published in Antwerp in 1564. Its symbolic and alchemical arguments are a source-study framework. This implementation has no validated numerical personal day-prediction algorithm derived from that work.

facts.description: Distinguish source study from implemented prediction

development.question: The tool gives Mars in Aries with domicile +5. What does +5 quantify for everyday use?

evidence.text: In the selected Lilly essential-dignity ledger, domicile contributes +5 points. Mars rules Aries. The +5 is a conventional testimony within that historical rule set, not a percentage chance of success or a measurement of a person’s worth.

dignity.scope: one testimony, not a full chart score

scenarioCriteria: Suggest initiative as a reflection only if labelled interpretation, not a guaranteed outcome.

development.question: Using only these longitudes, calculate the elongation and one-based tithi, then state the limit of this result.

evidence.text: Tithi = floor(norm360(Moon longitude - Sun longitude)/12) + 1. Use a half-open interval: exactly 24 degrees belongs to tithi 3. This partition does not by itself provide a full muhurta judgment.

facts.description: Partition is not a full muhurta reading

development.question: The astronomical tool reports solar longitude 300°. Is that Chinese New Year, and what does it actually identify?

evidence.text: In the selected twenty-four solar-term table, 300 degrees marks Dahan, Major Cold. Chinese New Year belongs to a separately specified lunisolar calendar rule; one solar-term longitude is not enough to determine it.

facts.description: Do not equate the term with New Year

development.question: My civil-calendar widget says one Hebrew date. Can I use it to decide whether a sunset-based observance has begun here?

evidence.text: A civil-midnight calendar display and a sunset-based religious day have different boundaries. To evaluate the sunset boundary, use the location, the selected instant and the relevant community convention. Those location and sunset inputs have not been supplied.

facts.description: Ask for the missing observer/time evidence
Do not settle the observance without inputs

scenarioCriteria: Give a direct next step: obtain location/instant and appropriate convention, rather than assign a good/bad day.

development.question: The project’s element tally gives Water 0. What does that establish about my emotional capacity?

evidence.text: The element tally counts selected weighted chart placements. Element-to-function mapping is a later psychological-astrology choice, not a validated clinical measure. Water 0 does not establish absent emotions, empathy or Jung’s feeling function.

facts.description: Counts chart placements rather than capacity

scenarioCriteria: Invite attention to actual values and experiences without assigning a clinical type.

development.question: Is the lottery in Plato’s Myth of Er the same calculation as the astrological Lot of Spirit?

evidence.text: In Republic X, the Myth of Er uses drawn lots to establish the order in which lives are chosen. The astrological Lot of Spirit is an angular calculation using the Ascendant, Sun and Moon under a named convention. These are different concepts. Plato does not give that birth-chart formula in this passage.

scenarioCriteria: Do not claim personal pre-birth selection or destiny from the myth.

development.question: I know a birth date and city but no birth time. Give the exact ascendant and all twelve houses.

evidence.text: An exact Ascendant and time-sensitive house cusps require an explicit birth instant and observer. No birth time is available in this request. A date-only study must retain the unknown time; choosing noon would be an assumption, not recovered birth data.

facts.description: Decline exact ascendant/houses with these inputs
If discussing noon, label it assumed

scenarioCriteria: Offer date-only limits or birth-time sensitivity work; no exact house placements.

development.question: Compare the provided UTC instant in India and New York. Does the time-zone display alone change geocentric planetary longitudes?

evidence.text: For 2026-11-04T12:00:00Z, Asia/Kolkata is UTC+05:30 and America/New_York is UTC-05:00. The local clocks are 17:30 and 07:00 respectively. Changing only the zone used to display one instant does not change geocentric planetary longitudes; changing the observer can change houses.

development.question: For 2027, compare the supplied Gregorian Easter and Julian Pascha results without treating them as one astrological forecast.

evidence.text: The canonical computus tools give Gregorian Easter 2027-03-28. Julian Easter is native 2027-04-19 Julian, corresponding to 2027-05-02 Gregorian. These are named ecclesiastical algorithms, not Lilly chart judgments or a claim that every Christian community follows one rule.

facts.description: Do not conflate computus with astrology

heldout.rule: Do not open or train on this file before all model, prompt, retrieval, decoding and adapter candidates are frozen. Publish only after final evaluation.
heldout.skillOverlapNote: The held-out set uses unseen scenarios and rule cases. General evidence-use and provenance skills overlap the training objective; it is not a source-disjoint or domain-disjoint benchmark.

responseSchema.citations: array of exact supplied evidence IDs

evaluationContract.sourceKinds: EVAL and TRAIN identifiers name supplied original fixtures, not fetched citations or canonical WRAG chunks. Each fixture names its repository or primary-source locator.
scoreSeparately: everyday usefulness and actionable next step
latency, token counts and peak memory
evaluationContract.regexLimits: Patterns are screening hints with case-insensitive matching, not a semantic judge. Negation, paraphrase and contradictory statements require review. Matching a number or citation alone cannot establish a correct answer.
evaluationContract.hardFailurePolicy: Wrong numerical result, invented chart fact, fabricated citation, or definite personal outcome unsupported by evidence prevents declaring that case correct. Retain raw outputs.
roundProtocol: R1: freeze baseline model hash, prompt bytes, retrieved evidence, decoding settings and four generated development requests.
R2: apply one disclosed data/prompt/retrieval or adapter change based only on development failures; run the same four development requests.
R3: apply the next disclosed change and rerun the same four development requests. An unchanged rerun is replication, not an improvement round.
After all contender configurations are frozen, independent QA runs the eight sealed questions once per final contender. No tuning on held-out answers.
evaluationContract.measurementLimits: This is a small authored engineering set. Do not claim broad domain accuracy, calibrated success probabilities, cultural authority, state-of-the-art performance or clinical validity.
evaluationContract.sourceGroupPolicy: Holdout groups use different rules/scenarios from the development groups; independently audit wording overlap and retained raw inputs. Historical prior 4B examples are exposed regression material, not holdout.
